items: Watering can with at least 1 use

st.t: Talk to Sylas by the house portal in Taverley.

Leave Taverley on its west side and take the trail farthest east up White Wolf Mountain, heading north. Go through the two white lines and follow the path up to Grimgnash, the griffin in the north east of the mountain. Talk to him.
s: I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
There once was a graveyard filled with undead.
There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
Started to strangle the poor gnome.
He saw some bones lying in the corner.

st.t: Once Grimgnash is asleep, steal a feather from the pile next to his nest.
Bring Sylas in Taverley a griffin feather.
Climb over the crumbling wall of the tower south east of Goblin Village.
Talk to the drain pipe.
Talk to the drain pipe again.
s: I think I might have an idea!
I could try and climb up.
Is there anything up there that can help?

st.t: Climb the beard.
Talk to Rupert the beard.
Climb down the beard.
Climb back over the crumbling east wall, then talk to Miazrqa just north of the tower.
s: I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf...
I need a key for the house.
I should be off, I think.

st.t: Go to the witch's house in Taverley, next to the house portal, and enter it with the door key.
Go down the ladder to the basement.
Play the piano. Press upper E-F-E-D-C, then lower A-E-G-A.
Long-press the piano and choose Search.
Add the shrunk ogleroot to both your tarromin potion (unf). You'll need the second potion for later in the quest.
Climb back up the ladder.
Go through the south door on the ground floor, stand next to the mouse hole and drink one shrink-me-quick. Keep the other potion for later.
Climb the nails in the north east of the room
Climb up the nails in the south west of the room.
Climb the nails in the south of the room.
Climb down the nails in the north east of the room.
Run north and climb up the next set of nails on the east wall.
Take the pendant and return to Miazrqa.
Return the pendant to Miazrqa.
Talk to Rupert the beard to get his helmet.
Bring Sylas in Taverley Rupert's helmet.
Plant the magic beans in the earth mound in south east Taverley
i: Watering can with at least 1 use

st.t: Use your watering can on the magic beans you just planted in the earth mound
i: Watering can with at least 1 use

st.t: Climb the bean stalk, ready to fight Glod.
Kill Glod.
Pick up the golden goblin.
Bring the golden goblin to Sylas in Taverley.
Use a shrink potion on the bean stalk.
Chop down the bean stalk.
Talk to Sylas in Taverley.
